text: 近期，A股市场震荡分化，热点板块轮动加速。在此背景下，兼具抗跌韧性与估值修复潜力的红利资产，凭借攻守兼备的特性，成为各路资金重点布局的优质赛道。Wind数据显示，截至10月12日，全市场红利基金总规模突破4200亿元，达4228.07亿元，较去年同期增长20.58%；年内新成立的相关产品合计54只。资金持续涌入、机构密集推新，共同推动红利基金总规模稳步抬升。（证券日报）
text_en: Recently, the A-share market has been fluctuating and diverging, with accelerated rotation among hot sectors. Against this backdrop, dividend assets, which combine downside resilience and valuation repair potential, have become a high-quality track for key allocation by various funds due to their dual offensive-defensive characteristics. Wind data shows that as of October 12, the total scale of dividend funds across the market exceeded 420 billion yuan, reaching 422.807 billion yuan, up 20.58% from the same period last year; a total of 54 related products were newly established during the year. Continuous inflows of funds and intensive launches by institutions have jointly driven the total scale of dividend funds steadily higher. (Securities Daily)
